transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I just don’t really feel happy anymore. Or close to people, even my wife. She tries to get us back into our old Sunday routines, and I just… don’t feel much. Even when something goes well at work, it doesn’t really land.
Have you noticed that you don’t take pleasure in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies, time with family, or other activities?

Yeah… I have. I don’t really get much out of things anymore. My wife tries to do our old Sunday stuff, and I just kind of go through it. Even when something good happens at work, I don’t feel… happy, really.
Do you feel down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say it like that, exactly. I’m not keeping track of most of the day. I just know things feel kind of flat a lot.
Do you feel down or sad most of the time, even when there’s nothing specific going on?
I’m not sure I’d call it sad, exactly. It’s more like… I don’t feel much. Just kind of flat, even when nothing’s happening.
Do you find yourself feeling down or in a depressed mood most of the time, even when there’s no clear reason for it?
I don’t really know. I wouldn’t call it depressed most of the time. It’s just… hard to say what it is.
Can you tell me if you feel down or in a depressed mood most of the day, even when you’re not at work or engaged in any particular activity?

It’s not exactly “down,” I guess. It’s more that I don’t really feel happy anymore. Even when my wife tries to do our Sunday stuff like we used to, or something goes well at work, I just… don’t feel much. Not close to it, if that makes sense.
Would you say that you feel a depressed mood or sadness most of the day, nearly every day, even when nothing specific is happening?
I don’t know if I’d say sadness most of the day. I haven’t really tracked it like that. It’s more just… kind of there or not there. Hard to put a name on.
Would you say that most days, you feel down or that you don’t enjoy things for most of the day, even when there’s nothing specific going on?

Yeah… I think it’s more that I don’t enjoy things. Most days, for a lot of the day, I just don’t feel real happiness or closeness. Even with our old Sunday routine, or if something goes well at work, it just doesn’t really land.
Would you say that most days, you feel down or in a depressed mood for most of the day, even when there’s nothing specific happening?
I’m not sure I’d call it depressed, exactly. Most days I just feel kind of flat. I don’t really have much more than that.
Would you say that most days, you feel a depressed mood for most of the day, even when nothing specific is happening?
I don’t really know. I wouldn’t say depressed most of the day… it’s more just hard to tell what I’m feeling.
Would you say that most days, you feel a depressed mood for most of the day, even when nothing specific is happening?
I… I don’t think I can say that clearly. It’s not like I wake up and think, “I’m depressed” all day. It’s more just… muted, I guess. Hard to pin down.
Would you say that on most days, you feel a depressed mood for most of the day, even when there’s nothing specific going on around you?
I don’t know. I guess I haven’t really tracked it that way… most of the day, most days. It’s just kind of hard for me to say.
Would you say that on most days, you experience a depressed mood for most of the day, even when there’s nothing specific going on around you?
I’m not sure. I don’t really think of it as “depressed” most of the day. It’s more like… I just don’t pay close attention to it, I guess.
Would you say that on most days, you feel a depressed mood for most of the day, even when there’s nothing specific going on around you?
I really don’t know how to answer it better than that. I don’t… measure it during the day. Sometimes I feel low, but whether it’s most days, most of the day… I can’t say.
Would you say that most days, you feel a depressed mood for most of the day, even when nothing specific is happening around you?
I don’t think I can say that clearly. I mean… some days I’m down, sure, but “most of the day, most days” feels too specific. I haven’t really noticed it in that way.
Would you say that on most days, you feel a depressed mood for most of the day, even when nothing specific is happening around you?
I… I don’t know. I can’t really pin it down like that. I know I have low stretches, but whether it’s most days and most of the day… I haven’t been tracking it.
Would you say that on most days, you feel a depressed mood for a significant part of the day, even when nothing specific is happening around you?
I’m not sure I can say it that way. I have times where I’m low, but whether it’s a significant part of most days… I don’t really know.
Would you say that on most days, you feel a depressed mood for a significant part of the day, even when nothing specific is happening around you?
I still don’t really know how to answer that. I get low sometimes, yeah, but I haven’t paid attention to whether it’s most days or how long it lasts.
Would you say that on most days, you feel a depressed mood for a significant part of the day, even when nothing specific is happening around you?
I don’t think I can give you a clear yes. I haven’t really measured it like that… I just know my mood drops sometimes, but I can’t say it’s most days or for a big part of the day.
Would you say that on most days, you feel a depressed mood for a significant part of the day, even when nothing specific is happening around you?
I guess… I still don’t know. It’s not something I’ve tracked. I can say I feel down sometimes, but whether it’s most days or for that much of the day, I’m not sure.
